  • Property rates and valuations

    Pay your property rates, manage your rates online with myAUCKLAND, help with paying property rates, get your property rates notice by email, apply for financial assistance to heat your home or change your address. Solicitors property rates services.

  • Consents, building and renovation projects

    Resource and building consents, inspections, pools and fencing, renovation projects, and planning zones. Also, information on earthworks, stormwater systems, engineering approvals, working on trees and more.

  • Rubbish, recycling and food scraps

    Collection dates, learn what you can put in your rubbish, recycling or food scraps bins, report a missed collection or dumped rubbish, find ways to dispose of unwanted items, or book an inorganic collection.

  • Contact us or report a problem

    Find out about the different ways to contact us to report a problem or ask us a question. Learn about our proactive approach to community safety and support.

  • Licences and regulations

    Licences, permits and rules for selling food and alcohol, fundraising, busking, fires, promotions, displays and events. Health and beauty and other businesses. Noise and signs.

  • Plans, policies, bylaws, reports and projects

    The Auckland Plan, The Auckland Unitary Plan, 10-year budget, annual budget, bylaws, policies, projects, annual reports, strategies.

  • Environment

    Air and water quality, stormwater, biosecurity, sustainability and how you can help the environment.

  • About Auckland Council

    How Auckland Council works, local elections, finances, procurement, official information and privacy, council-controlled organisations, executive lead team and elected representatives.

  • Arts, culture and heritage

    Public art, galleries and theatres, artists in residence, heritage preservation and trails, archives.

  • Buying property

    Order a property report, browse GeoMaps, find the value of your property, and read our home buyers' guide

  • Cemeteries

    Cemetery records, locations, plot booking and venue hire.

  • Dogs and other animals

    Adopt a dog, register your dog, change your dog owner details, search lost and found dogs, pay a dog fine, or find where you can walk your dog.

  • Have your say and help shape Auckland

    Have your say on a proposal or at a meeting and help us to shape Auckland. Public notices, hearings, notified resource consents and the People's Panel.

  • Parks, recreation and community venues

    Find parks, pools, leisure centres, libraries, walking or cycling tracks, wharves or boat ramps. Book venues, sports fields, campsites or swimming lessons.

  • Recovery from extreme weather and natural disasters

    Find out more about the repair and regeneration of Auckland after natural disasters and extreme weather events.

  • Grants, community support and housing

    Apply for funding or view information about housing and other community support.

  • Use our geospatial tools

    Find out about our geospatial tools and how to use them.
